<?php
class PeerPayload199 { public function __construct(public string $tag) {} public function __destruct() { echo 'PAY-', $this->tag, ';'; } }
function peerShift199() { global $owner, $alias; $owner = null; $alias[1]->tag = 'SHARED'; $alias[0] = 99; $alias[1] = new PeerPayload199('NEW'); echo 'SHIFT;'; return 9; }
class PeerBase199 { private static function secret() { return 'PRIVATE'; } public function __call(string $name, array $arguments) { echo 'MAGIC;'; return static function () use ($arguments, $name) { echo 'CLOSURE:', self::secret(), ':', self::class, ':', static::class, ':', __METHOD__, ';'; return new class($arguments, $name) { public function __construct(public array $saved, public string $name) {} public function __destruct() { echo 'CHILD;'; } }; }; } public function __destruct() { echo 'OWNER;'; } }
class PeerDerived199 extends PeerBase199 {}
$owner = new PeerDerived199; $argument = [7, new PeerPayload199('OLD')]; $alias =& $argument; $factory = $owner->MiSsInG(first: $argument, later: peerShift199()); echo 'RETURN;'; $slot = null; $argument =& $slot; unset($alias); echo 'DETACHED;'; $child = $factory(); unset($factory); echo $child->saved['first'][0], ':', $child->saved['first'][1]->tag, ':', $child->saved['later'], ':', $child->name, ';'; unset($child); echo 'AFTER;';
